description: Lists US FDA medical device recalls matching a product or firm name (for example "insulin pump", "CPAP", "Philips"), newest posted first, with the reason, root cause, what users were told to do, quantity and distribution. Useful for patients, clinicians and procurement teams checking whether a device type or maker has had recalls in the United States. Source: FDA device recall database via openFDA. US recalls only (not UK MHRA field safety notices); it does not confirm whether a specific serial number is affected, and this endpoint does not carry the Class I/II/III recall severity. (cost: 1 credit)

limit.description: integer, optional, 1-50, number of recalls to return, default 10

query.description: string, required, device description or recalling firm name, e.g. "insulin pump" or "Medtronic"

name: fda_device_recalls
